text: In July 2024, a court in Abu Dhabi sentenced 43 people, including human rights defenders, to life in prison after a mass trial that human rights monitors called unfair.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: UAE: Unfair Mass Trial Convictions Upheld
source.quote: In July 2024, the court sentenced 43 defendants to life in prison, 5 to 15 years, 5 to 10 years, and dismissed the criminal cases against 24 others.

additionalSources.name: UN OHCHR (Special Procedures): United Arab Emirates: Experts dismayed by life sentences handed down to human rights defenders
additionalSources.quote: Independent experts were shocked at the sentencing to life imprisonment of 43 people, including human rights defenders and activists on 10 July 2024 by the Abu Dhabi Court of Appeal.
